impact: Replay exports complete successfully (FSM healthy per T-029/ISS-012 diagnostics), but replay artifacts show deterministic vertical striping with preserved scene geometry. Corruption screenshot strongly suggests stride/pixel-format mismatch. Observed on NVIDIA GPU, KDE Plasma 6, Wayland, SHM fallback likely active, logs showed codec=vp8.
title: Replay artifacts show deterministic vertical striping with preserved scene geometry
